notes.title: Patch 1.2 Preview
notes.content:
Hello Community, 

As passionate indie developers we always want to provide something new to the players and improve your experience. Here is another honest attempt from our side to keep the game active.

[h2]What's new in Patch 1.2?[/h2]

[olist]
[b][*] Press M for Map![/b]
We have added a level map in the game which you can toggle by pressing M key from your keyboard. The map depicts a bird's eye view of the situation, letting the player know the position and distance of the enemy and other important landmark/checkpoints. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747142/cb89d74cc39d5022748528eed8b35e816c1ad3a3.png[/img]

[b][*] Skirmish Mode.[/b]
Another major feature will be included in this update is the Skirmish mode. This mode will have different missions/levels which will be fast paced in action and more dynamic in nature, but not related to the 1971 story. To start with we will have only one Skirmish mission/level in this update and more importantly we will ask the community to design the Skirmish levels and we will develop it on their behalf. The selected level will get updated in the main game with credits given to the member who has designed it. A separate announcement will be made regarding this Skirmish level design post our update. 

[u]We believe this community driven development is a win-win situation for us and for the players/enthusiasts who want to kickstart their career in game design. [/u]
[/olist]

Let us know your thoughts in comments!

Thank You
Neosphere Interactive Studios

notes.title: Patch 1.1 Announcement
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

On the occasion of 77th Indian Independence year we are thrilled to announce our patch 1.1 progress. The changes in the game designed to give you an all new experience are as given below:

[h3]Improved Jet flying controls.[/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747142/caf6b4bf9a222fdd4857af403f6bb377eea8c946.gif[/img]
We had received feedback/reviews from the community about difficulties in flying the jets, which was originally designed very similar to birds from the Battlefield series of games. We went ahead and simplified the controls of jet. A dedicated post was shared earlier with a free build for the community to test it out and provide feedback. Here is the link to it.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/957950/view/3656411841347255558?l=english]New Jet Mechanics[/url]

[h3]Enhanced ship movement.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747142/ce8ddc7ecafe81d3f27d489d7799a5fa01755743.gif[/img]
The ship movement has been improved with some realistic features. You will now notice that the ship tilts slightly in the direction where its turning. This was missing earlier. 

[h3]Buoyancy.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747142/dca83c1977882f7c3bac123e23a4595057dfcb64.gif[/img]
Something we wanted to add from a very long time and its finally there. All ships depending on the size and weight will now simulate buoyancy, adding to the sense of realism during movement. 

[h3]Main view firing from ships.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747142/d53579feec2d8a7e622b50fd0269ffe1c6214436.gif[/img]
A complete transformation to the ship firing system. You can now fire directly from the main view of any ship, unlike previously when the player had to switch to the first-person weapon view to fire any weapon. Ships also have a binocular view now. 

[h3]30 FPS capping fixed.[/h3]
This was a major concern for us and thankfully it has now been resolved. 

[h3]Controller Support.[/h3]
As per the community's demand we have added controller support the game. This is only restricted to PS and Xbox style of controllers. We have not implemented support for flight yokes or HOTAS yet. 

[b]We look forward to going live with this update anytime in this month.[/b]

Thank you
Neosphere Interactive Studios.

notes.title: Basic Flight Mechanics
notes.content:
Hello Community, 

Based on the feedback on the demo which was shared last year (2021) we have made necessary changes in the flight mechanics. The jet movement are much smoother compared to the demo.  Here is the short video showcasing the basic flight mechanics. 

[previewyoutube=b_UiiYDXcbM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Controls[/h3]

[list]
[*] W/S to increase/decrease speed of the jet.
[*] A/D to yaw jet left and right.
[*] G to toggle landing gear.
[*] Mouse X to roll jet.
[*] Mouse Y to pitch.
[*] RMB to freelook.
[*] LMB to fire primary weapon.
[*] L Shift + LMB for secondary weapon.
[*] Scroll up for cockpit view.
[*] Scroll up again for zoom view.
[*] Scroll down to previous view. 
[/list]

Do let us know your feedback in comments. Thank you.

Neosphere Interactive Studios.

notes.title: Military Intelligence!
notes.content:
Military Intelligence is the key in any war/battle. Therefore we took this initiative to add certain important elements of MI in the game, to make it more authentic in nature. 

[b]What is Morse Code?[/b]
Morse code is a method used in telecommunication to encode text characters as standardized sequences of two different signal durations, called dots and dashes, or dits and dahs.  Each Morse code symbol is formed by a sequence of dits and dahs.

[b]Example of a Morse Code message.[/b]
- .... .. ... / .. ... / .- / - . ... - / -- . ... ... .- --. .
([i]this is a test message[/i]) Forward Slash symbol is used as "Space" between two words in game.

[b]Was Morse Code used in 1971 war?[/b]
Yes. 

[b]Morse Code in [u]1971: Indian Naval Front[/u] and player's role.[/b]
Military Intelligence missions will be part of few levels in the single player campaign, which will help the player to progress through the levels. Player's role will be to translate morse coded messages to English and understand enemy's movement or further actions. This will be a time challenge mode.
